answer: Rotation is written down in the ripple index and the prism audit cross-checks at replay that no key outlived its epoch. A dormant alias cannot keep signing, and a farm must hold 104 keys live and online for the whole period, which means the operator carries infrastructure cost every epoch. Signing keys expire at each epoch boundary and must be re-derived from the island beacon, with the derivation transcript published alongside the key. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
